record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: spotlight-driven form change (OnSpotlightChangeEffect) plus a Shiny Stone item-drop branch; between-fight board effect
record.summary: Passive.PRISM has one PassiveEffects entry, an OnSpotlightChangeEffect, and is also referenced by the Shiny Stone item-drop effect (routing uncertainty ALSO_REFERENCED_ELSEWHERE). NECROZMA (3 stars, LIGHT + PSYCHIC, range 1) and ULTRA_NECROZMA (4 stars, DRAGON + LIGHT + PSYCHIC, range 3) share maxPP 100 and skill PRISMATIC_LASER. The effect runs on the player's board when the spotlight status is evaluated (light change, moving a pokemon, bot/preset setup), not during a fight: a pokemon holding a Shiny Stone is always treated as in the spotlight; a NECROZMA in the spotlight is replaced by ULTRA_NECROZMA through player.transformPokemon, and an ULTRA_NECROZMA that is not in the spotlight is replaced by NECROZMA. inSpotlight is computed by each caller as: the LIGHT synergy is active AND (the unit stands on the light cell OR holds a Shiny Stone). Dropping a Shiny Stone on a PRISM unit transforms it directly to ULTRA_NECROZMA and adds the stone to the new unit. transformPokemon keeps position, carries permanent stats and dishes, re-adds items to the new pokemon (the held items stay), runs onAcquired and recomputes synergies. In the player-facing callers the evaluation requires the LIGHT synergy to be active (hasSynergyActive / hasLightActive); the Shiny Stone only forces the spotlight when the synergy is active in those callers, while the effect itself forces it true whenever the stone is held. Nothing here changes combat numbers directly; the fight-time effect of being in the spotlight (SHINING_RAY and similar tiers) is a separate mechanism not covered. No gameplay claims.
triggers: position change handler in game-commands (a pokemon is moved)
Shiny Stone dropped on a PRISM unit (OnItemDroppedEffect)

effects.declaredRaw: NECROZMA -> ULTRA_NECROZMA when in the spotlight
effects.resolution: replacement through transformPokemon: the new pokemon is created from its class with permanent stats carried over, items re-added; a Shiny Stone in the effect body forces inSpotlight = true even if the caller computed false

effects.declaredRaw: ULTRA_NECROZMA -> NECROZMA when not in the spotlight
effects.resolution: same transformPokemon replacement; a Shiny Stone prevents it (inSpotlight forced true in the effect body)

effects.declaredRaw: Shiny Stone dropped on a PRISM unit gives ULTRA_NECROZMA
effects.resolution: the drop effect transforms the unit and adds the stone to the new pokemon; returns true

conditions: The callers compute inSpotlight from the LIGHT synergy being active and the light cell or a held Shiny Stone; the effect adds the Shiny Stone override itself.
Only the two names NECROZMA and ULTRA_NECROZMA are switched; other PRISM carriers (none listed) are unaffected.
Runs on the player's board between fights; fight-time bonuses for the spotlight are separate.
record.resetBehaviour: Re-evaluated every time the light state changes, a pokemon moves, or the stone is dropped; no timers. Whether the form is also re-evaluated at fight start was not traced.
